rules.statement: A party who has obtained an interlocutory decree does not need to prove their title afresh against every successive intervenient unless the latter establishes their right to intervene.
rules.supporting_quote: "There is no requirement for a party who has obtained an interlocutory decree to prove his title afresh against every successive intervenient (Appuhamy v. Gunaratne1[Wijewardena's Reports 60.])."
